'''Shroom steak''' was a type of [[Steak/Legends|steak]] made on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] that was served in the chow hall of [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]] [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7|7]], a field hospital located on the planet during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MedStar I" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chief Surgeon]] [[Jos Vondar]] had a meal of shroom steaks and [[hawk-bat egg]]s in the chow hall, and found the steaks to be palatable since they were local.<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shroom steaks first appeared in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', a [[2004]] [[Clone Wars multimedia project|''Clone Wars'']] novel written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]] as the first part of the ''[[MedStar Duology]]''.<ref name="MedStar I" />
